scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=packages/pdf-template
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
